jobs.title: Finance Business Partner (m/f/d)
jobs.description: At Knuspr , Finance is not a back-office function. It’s a core driver of how we make decisions, run smarter operations, and scale sustainably. As a Finance Business Partner, you will act as a critical co-pilot to our Operations (Fulfilment Centres) and Commercial leadership. This is a hands-on, high-exposure role where you will be embedded directly in the day-to-day business—turning financial data and operational metrics into actionable decisions that directly influence our profitability and growth. Why this role is exciting Direct business impact: Your insights, business cases, and analysis will directly shape operational efficiency, commercial initiatives, and unit economics. True business partnering: You won't just report numbers after month-end; you’ll work side-by-side with Operations and Commercial Directors to challenge how things are done and drive change. Speed and autonomy: We move fast and avoid rigid corporate red tape—good ideas and viable solutions get tested and implemented quickly without layers of approval. Cross-functional visibility: You will act as the key bridge connecting finance, logistics, commercial strategy, and leadership across the business. Dynamic scale: You will solve real operational and systemic challenges in a fast-paced, high-volume e-commerce environment. What you will own and deliver Partner with leadership: Serve as the trusted finance partner for Operations and Commercial Directors, challenging existing setups and advising on strategic and operational decisions. Drive performance analysis: Deliver ad-hoc deep dives, scenario modelling, and business cases to evaluate new projects, operational investments, and commercial opportunities. Identify efficiencies: Spot operational bottlenecks, cost drivers, and financial risks across our fulfilment network and commercial operations, proposing concrete solutions to fix them. Financial planning & reviews: Collaborate closely on budgeting, rolling forecasts, monthly financial performance

jobs.description: The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. We’re looking for a People Experience Administrator Keep the employee journey running smoothly for iwocans across the UK and Germany. You'll support payroll in both countries, run onboarding and offboarding, and be the first port of call for questions. The team The People Operations team's mission is to attract, develop and retain high performers who genuinely love being part of iwoca. The People Experience team handles the nuts and bolts of the entire employee journey, from onboarding and offboarding to background checks and visa paperwork. It looks after HR systems like BambooHR and Peakon, keeps policies up to date, and manages benefits and payroll. The team is the first point of contact for most People Operations questions. The role As our People Experience Administrator, you'll be the first point of contact for iwocans and the person who keeps the employee journey running smoothly, from someone's first day to their last. Remboursements clients, facturation, suivi de la trésorerie ou fiabilité des données : tu travailleras sur des sujets concrets, au contact de l’équipe et des demandes du quotidien. L’objectif collectif : ne laisser aucun ticket ouvert à la fin de la semaine ; Fiabiliser nos données : identifier et corriger les incohérences pour disposer de données financières fiables et à jour ; Participer aux opérations financières : contribuer à la facturation clients, au suivi de la trésorerie et au paiement des fournisseurs ; Contribuer au reporting : participer à la préparation des reportings et à la réalisation d’analyses simples pour accompagner le suivi de l’activité ; Découvrir d’autres sujets Finance : selon ta progression, participer aux échanges avec le cabinet comptable et les auditeurs, et contribuer à l’amélioration de nos processus grâce aux outils no-code ou à l’IA. Ton parcours d’apprentissage Pas besoin de tout maîtriser avant de nous rejoindre : ce stage est justement là pour te permettre d’apprendre ! jobs.description: Du studierst und willst mehr als einen „Nebenjob“? Du willst Verantwortung, klare Ziele und ein Umfeld, in dem Leistung zählt? Dann ist diese Werkstudentenrolle dein Einstieg in die Finanzberatung, mit strukturiertem Onboarding, Coaching und einem klaren Weg in ein Trainee-Programm. Diese Rolle ist unternehmerisch geprägt und bietet dir die Möglichkeit, dich aktiv einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Leistung und Eigeninitiative spielen dabei eine zentrale Rolle, gleichzeitig wirst du durch strukturiertes Onboarding, Coaching und ein erfahrenes Team unterstützt. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1+) sind erforderlich, da die Ausbildung, die Kommunikation im Team sowie die Perspektive Richtung IHK vollständig auf Deutsch stattfinden. Dein Aufgabenbereich Startphase (erste Wochen): Terminaufbau: Du vereinbarst Kundentermine (Telefon, Netzwerk, Leads) und baust eine saubere Pipeline auf. Prozesslernen: Du lernst Gesprächsleitfäden, Bedarfsermittlung, Nachbereitung und Dokumentationsstandards. Performance-Optimierung: Du arbeitest mit KPIs, bekommst Feedback und verbesserst systematisch deine Ergebnisse. Im weiteren Verlauf: Analyse & Vorbereitung: Du unterstützt bei der Analyse von Kundensituationen und bereitest Beratungsunterlagen strukturiert vor. Kundenkontakt: Du begleitest Gespräche (je nach Stand), übernimmst Follow-ups und sorgst für klare nächste Schritte. Dokumentation & Organisation: Du hältst Prozesse sauber, dokumentierst konsequent und stellst Verlässlichkeit sicher. jobs.description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high.
